context_requirements: Expression of xanthine oxidase (XDH) is not sufficient for a transcriptional response in the assayed cell lines.
Substrate availability (hypoxanthine/xanthine) and reactive oxygen species generation at levels that perturb transcription.
The 978-landmark gene panel may not capture the metabolic and oxidative-stress genes most directly affected by XDH inhibition.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines.
Enrichment of an oxidative-stress or purine-metabolism transcriptional signature after treatment.
Shared transcriptional response with other xanthine oxidase inhibitors that is absent with inactive analogs.
